acceptance_tier: LOCAL cross-algorithm consistency check on the same recording as the FAST-LIVO2 check; no ground truth, not an independent accuracy tier.

source_data.conversion: ROS 1 bag -> rosbag2/mcap; /livox/lidar CustomMsg -> sensor_msgs/PointCloud2 (x y z intensity tag line offset_time), images and IMU byte-identical, timestamps unchanged

implementation.slam: Coco-LIC (APRIL-ZJU/Coco-LIC, continuous-time non-uniform B-spline LiDAR-inertial-camera odometry) via KaiFeng-Frank/Coco-LIC-ROS2-Jazzy
implementation.mode: LICO (lidar + IMU + camera); LIO-only run reported for reference
local_changes: five upstream (APRIL-ZJU) defects fixed before the 360-degree MID-360S data would run: forward-FOV point filter (x>0.7) -> radial; empty no-lidar window crash; spline index lookup without fallback; unclamped spline segment; images 640/1280 px wide hard-resized to 640x512
none of the five touches calibration inputs; the image-resize fix matters here because it is what makes the 1280x720 intrinsics apply to the image actually used

CameraExtrinsics (camera -> imu).derivation: Coco-LIC parameterises camera->IMU directly: T_camera_imu = T_camera_lidar * T_lidar_imu

img_time_offset_s.note: same sign convention and value as FAST-LIVO2 (t_image = stamp + offset)

cross_algorithm_consistency_vs_fastlivo2.baseline: FAST-LIVO2 trajectory from the 1x replay (fastlivo2_downstream_validation.json), 1376 poses at 10 Hz
cross_algorithm_consistency_vs_fastlivo2.method: nearest-timestamp association (<= 20 ms), then a yaw + xyz-translation alignment (no scale) because the two estimators use different world frames; statistics are on the remaining per-pose position difference

LICO_1280x720_images.note: same config run twice; Coco-LIC is multi-threaded and not bit-reproducible, differences below ~0.03 m are run-to-run noise

cross_algorithm_consistency_vs_fastlivo2.where_the_max_is: 70-80 s in every run, the stretch next to the window; which estimator is off there cannot be decided without ground truth

path_length_m.note: 15 % shorter: FAST-LIVO2 discrete poses jitter (max step 123 mm), the continuous-time spline does not (15 mm)

criteria: runs to completion on the full recording with the calibration used verbatim (composed camera->IMU)
loop closure within 0.02 m of FAST-LIVO2's (1.45 vs 1.46 m from start)
per-pose agreement with FAST-LIVO2 at the 0.1 m level over ~90 % of the run
camera images re-projected onto Coco-LIC's own map with the composed extrinsic colour 95 % of the points without visible smearing across geometry
not_claimed: which estimator is right in the 70-80 s window

render.tool: headless numpy/PIL from /points_for_gs + /pose_for_gs of Coco-LIC's mapper-contract bag (camera-FOV points coloured by Coco-LIC), camera inset from the source bag; same camera as the FAST-LIVO2 GIF
